boss_drops_price_check.name: boss_drops_price_check
boss_drops_price_check.value:
("boss_drops"."price_status" = 'entered') = ("boss_drops"."sale_price_meso" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("boss_drops"."sale_price_meso" IS NULL) = ("boss_drops"."sale_received_meso" IS NULL)
          AND ("boss_drops"."sale_price_meso" IS NULL) = ("boss_drops"."priced_at" IS NULL)

boss_drops_split_check.name: boss_drops_split_check
boss_drops_split_check.value: "boss_drops"."split_type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'excluded' AND "boss_drops"."split_share_millipercent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000

boss_profit_entries_cleared_character_bo.name: boss_profit_entries_cleared_character_boss_period_unique
boss_profit_entries_cleared_character_bo.where: "boss_profit_entries"."clear_recorded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "boss_profit_entries"."deleted_at" IS NULL

boss_profit_entries_cleared_check.name: boss_profit_entries_cleared_check
boss_profit_entries_cleared_check.value:
("boss_profit_entries"."clear_recorded_by" IS NULL) = ("boss_profit_entries"."crystal_price_meso" IS NULL)
          AND ("boss_profit_entries"."clear_recorded_by" IS NULL) = ("boss_profit_entries"."crystal_received_meso" IS NULL)

boss_profit_entries_split_check.name: boss_profit_entries_split_check
boss_profit_entries_split_check.value:
("boss_profit_entries"."split_type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'excluded'
            OR ("boss_profit_entries"."party_size" IS NULL AND "boss_profit_entries"."split_share_millipercent" IS NULL))
          AND "boss_profit_entries"."split_share_millipercent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000

boss_profit_entries_fee_check.name: boss_profit_entries_fee_check
boss_profit_entries_fee_check.value:
CASE WHEN "boss_profit_entries"."clear_recorded_by" IS NOT NULL
               THEN "boss_profit_entries"."split_type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ratio' OR "boss_profit_entries"."split_fee_percent" IS NOT NULL
               ELSE ("boss_profit_entries"."split_fee_follows_mvp_grade" = ("boss_profit_entries"."split_fee_percent" IS NULL)) END

boss_split_settings_split_check.name: boss_split_settings_split_check
boss_split_settings_split_check.value:
("boss_split_settings"."split_type" <> 'excluded' OR ("boss_split_settings"."party_size" IS NULL AND "boss_split_settings"."split_share_millipercent" IS NULL))
          AND "boss_split_settings"."split_share_millipercent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000

cashbook_entry_items_target_check.name: cashbook_entry_items_target_check
cashbook_entry_items_target_check.value:
("cashbook_entry_items"."target_type" IS NULL) = ("cashbook_entry_items"."target_id" IS NULL)
          AND ("cashbook_entry_items"."item_name" IS NULL OR "cashbook_entry_items"."target_id" IS NULL)

hunt_loot_items_npc_price.name: hunt_loot_items_npc_price
hunt_loot_items_npc_price.value: ("hunt_loot_items"."type" = 'consumable') = ("hunt_loot_items"."npc_price_meso" IS NOT NULL) AND ("hunt_loot_items"."npc_price_meso" IS NULL OR "hunt_loot_items"."npc_price_meso" > 0)

nexon_accounts_referral_code_login_only.name: nexon_accounts_referral_code_login_only
nexon_accounts_referral_code_login_only.value: ("nexon_accounts"."uid_hash" IS NOT NULL) = ("nexon_accounts"."referral_code" IS NOT NULL)

notices_scheduled_at_idx.name: notices_scheduled_at_idx
notices_scheduled_at_idx.where: "notices"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "notices"."sent_at" IS NULL

party_appointments_schedule_check.name: party_appointments_schedule_check
party_appointments_schedule_check.value:
("party_appointments"."schedule_type" = 'once' AND "party_appointments"."date" IS NOT NULL AND "party_appointments"."weekday" IS NULL
             AND "party_appointments"."from_week_code" IS NULL AND "party_appointments"."until_week_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("party_appointments"."schedule_type" = 'weekly' AND "party_appointments"."date" IS NULL AND "party_appointments"."weekday" IS NOT NULL
             AND "party_appointments"."from_week_code" IS NOT NULL)
